sources.entry: SAMA - Next-Gen self-hosted chat server and clients. (Demo, Source Code, Clients) GPL-3.0 Nodejs/Docker

summary.one_liner: React web client for the SAMA self-hosted chat server, run from a Vite-based monorepo workspace.
summary.what_it_does: This repository contains the frontend web app for the SAMA chat server. The README describes it as a React client and points to a separate SAMA server project and a deployment guide for the wider stack. Setup involves copying an example .env file, generating VAPID keys with the web-push tool for push notifications, installing npm dependencies, and building a shared SDK workspace (@sama-communications/sdk) that provides the SAMA API. The README says the full stack can be tried on a public cloud instance. The README does not detail specific chat features beyond this.
use_cases: testing a chat server stack in the cloud
how_to_run: Set up the SAMA server first, following its development guide
Generate VAPID keys with: npx web-push generate-vapid-keys and set the public key as VITE_PUBLIC_VAPID_KEY in .env
notable: Client for a self-hosted chat server, with a companion SAMA server project
Monorepo layout with a shared SDK workspace for the SAMA API
Web push notifications configured via VAPID keys
Public cloud option for trying the full stack
caveats: Requires the separate SAMA server to be set up first; this repo is only the web client
README gives only development-level setup instructions and no production deployment steps for this client
Listing mentions Docker, but the README does not describe Docker setup for this repo
